第 140 章 九人联手合围破晓（第1页）
就在虚实结界即将破碎的瞬间，一道金光突然射来，击中了破晓君王的手臂。
紧接着，杨戬也冲了上来，三尖两刃刀化作一道金光，朝着破晓君王劈去。
张二狗和申公豹也趁机挣脱了能量触手，电磁脉冲弹和诡道符同时朝着破晓君王射去。
“一群蝼蚁，也敢螳臂当车！”破晓君王冷哼一声，随手一挥，将所有的攻击都挡了下来。
瞬间，无数个庄周的分身出现在战场上，将破晓君王团团围住。
“没用的，这些幻象，根本伤不到我！”破晓君王怒吼一声，周身紫色能量暴涨，将所有的分身都震碎。
但就在这时，悟空和哪吒已经冲了上来。
悟空怒吼一声，将金箍棒变得巨大无比，朝着破晓君王狠狠砸去。
哪吒也同时发动攻击，周身逆火暴涨，形成了一道巨大的火柱，朝着破晓君王射去。
一道紫色的能量护盾出现在他的面前，挡住了悟空和哪吒的攻击。
金箍棒和火柱同时击中护盾，发出震耳欲聋的巨响。
护盾剧烈地颤抖起来，但并没有破碎。
“就这点实力，也想伤我？”破晓君王不屑地说道。
就在这时，申公豹突然出现在破晓君王的身后，手中的匕首朝着破晓君王的后心刺去。
破晓君王猛地转身，一把抓住了申公豹的手腕。
他猛地一用力，将申公豹甩了出去。
申公豹重重地摔在地上，吐出了一大口鲜血。
后羿抓住机会，拉满射日弓，一支凝聚了他全部灵力的破甲箭，朝着破晓君王的眉心射去。
箭矢如同流星般射出，带着尖锐的破空声。
破晓君王心中一惊，连忙偏头躲避。
箭矢擦着他的脸颊飞过，在他的脸上留下了一道浅浅的血痕。
“你竟然敢伤我？！”破晓君王彻底愤怒了，“我要把你们全部碎尸万段！”
他周身紫色能量疯狂翻涌，准备发动最强一击。
“大家一起上！”庄周大喊一声，“九人封神战队，合体！”
虽然巨灵神已经牺牲，神农女昏迷不醒，但剩下的七人，加上庄周，八人同时发动了攻击。
悟空正面强攻，哪吒侧翼突袭，杨戬天眼锁定，后羿远程狙杀，张二狗电磁干扰，申公豹诡道偷袭，庄周则在一旁不断催动蝶力，改写战场规则。
八人各司其职，配合默契，形成了一个完美的攻击闭环。
他们的攻击，如同潮水般朝着破晓君王涌去。
破晓君王虽然实力强大，但面对八人的联手围攻，也渐渐感到了吃力。
紫色的神王血液，顺着伤口流淌下来。
“不可能！我是神王！我怎么可能被你们这些卑微的土著打败！”破晓君王疯狂地咆哮着，发动了更加猛烈的攻击。
为了巨灵神，为了神农女，为了所有死去的兄弟，为了九州的百姓，他们必须赢！
一场凡人逆伐神王的终极之战，已经全面打响。
阳光洒在众人的身上，为他们镀上了一层金色的光芒。
他们的身影，在战火中显得无比高大。
胜利的曙光，已经在前方缓缓升起。

Chapter 140 Nine people join forces to encircle Dawn (page 1)
Just when the barrier between reality and reality was about to break, a golden light suddenly shot out and hit the arm of the King of Dawn.
Immediately afterwards, Yang Jian also rushed up, and the three-pointed two-edged sword turned into a golden light and struck towards the King of Dawn.
Zhang Ergou and Shen Gongbao also took the opportunity to break free from the energy tentacles, and shot electromagnetic pulse bombs and deception talismans at the Dawn King at the same time.
"How dare a group of ants use a mantis as a chariot!" King Dawn snorted coldly and blocked all the attacks with a wave of his hand.
In an instant, countless clones of Zhuang Zhou appeared on the battlefield, surrounding the King of Dawn.
"It's useless, these illusions can't hurt me at all!" King Daybreak roared, and the purple energy around him surged, shattering all the clones.
But at this moment, Wukong and Nezha had already rushed forward.
Wukong roared angrily, turned the golden cudgel into a huge one, and smashed it towards the King of Dawn.
Nezha also launched an attack at the same time, and the backfire around him surged, forming a huge pillar of fire and shooting towards the Dawn King.
A purple energy shield appeared in front of him, blocking Wukong and Nezha's attacks.
The golden cudgel and the fire pillar hit the shield at the same time, making a deafening noise.
The shield trembled violently, but did not shatter.
"With this little strength, you want to hurt me?" King Daybreak said disdainfully.
At this moment, Shen Gongbao suddenly appeared behind the Dawn King, and stabbed the Dawn King in the back with the dagger in his hand.
The Dawn King suddenly turned around and grabbed Shen Gongbao's wrist.
With a sudden force, he threw Shen Gongbao away.
Shen Gongbao fell heavily to the ground and spit out a large mouthful of blood.
Hou Yi seized the opportunity, fully drew the sun-shooting bow, and shot an armor-piercing arrow with all his spiritual power towards the eyebrows of the King of Dawn.
The arrows shot out like meteors, making a sharp sound as they shot through the air.
The Dawn King was startled and quickly turned his head to avoid it.
The arrow flew past his cheek, leaving a shallow blood mark on his face.
"How dare you hurt me?!" King Daybreak was completely angry, "I will tear you all into pieces!"
The purple energy around him surged crazily, preparing to launch the strongest attack.
"Everyone, come together!" Zhuang Zhou shouted, "The nine-member God-conferring Team, unite!"
Although the giant spirit god had been sacrificed and Shen Nong Nu was unconscious, the remaining seven people, including Zhuang Zhou, launched an attack at the same time.
Wukong attacked from the front, Nezha attacked from the flank, Yang Jian's eyes were locked, Hou Yi sniped from a distance, Zhang Ergou interfered with electromagnetic interference, Shen Gongbao attacked sneakily, and Zhuang Zhou kept urging the butterfly power on the side to rewrite the rules of the battlefield.
The eight people each performed their own duties and cooperated with each other tacitly, forming a perfect closed attack loop.
Their attacks surged towards the King of Dawn like a tide.
Although the King of Dawn was powerful, he gradually found it difficult to face the joint siege of eight people.
The purple blood of the God King flowed down the wound.
"Impossible! I am the God King! How could I be defeated by you humble natives!" The King of Dawn roared crazily and launched an even more violent attack.
For the sake of the Giant Spirit God, for the Shennong Girl, for all the dead brothers, and for the people of Kyushu, they must win!
The ultimate battle between mortals and the God-King has begun.
The sun shone on everyone's bodies, coating them with a layer of golden light.
Their figures looked extremely tall in the flames of war.
The dawn of victory has slowly risen ahead.
